title: Learning to Refine: Self-Refinement of Parallel Reasoning in LLMs
authors_zh: Qibin Wang、Pu Zhao、Shaohan Huang、Fangkai Yang、Lu Wang、Furu Wei、Qingwei Lin、Saravan Rajmohan、Dongmei Zhang（机构：Microsoft、北京大学）
paper_type_zh: 学习式并行测试时扩展与反思研究
best_for_zh: 正在构建多样本推理系统、但需要答案生成器而非仅投票、奖励模型或重排序器的读者。
one_line: GSR trains one model to generate and then synthesize a better solution from parallel candidates, allowing test-time scaling to recover answers even when voting candidates are all wrong.
GSR 训练同一模型先生成并行候选，再从中综合出更好的答案，使测试时扩展即使在投票候选全错时也可能恢复正确解。
why: It identifies learned refinement as a distinct scaling capability and provides a matched-budget metric showing when it adds value beyond majority voting.
inclusion_reason: It changes the test-time consumer of parallel candidates from voting or ranking to learned generation of a refined answer, and measures the resulting compute-scaling behavior against matched candidate budgets.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Parallel test-time scaling normally samples several solutions and then selects one by majority vote or by a reward model. These procedures can exploit a correct proposal if it is present, but cannot construct a correct solution when every sampled candidate is flawed. Sequential self-refinement is not a complete remedy: smaller models can fail to criticize their own reasoning and may degrade with additional reflection, so more tokens do not necessarily create a useful correction process.

The paper asks whether refinement is a distinct capability beyond candidate coverage and how it can be made available to smaller models. A valid comparison must hold the candidate pool fixed, because otherwise a self-refinement gain can be mistaken for the ordinary benefit of sampling more answers. The target inference behavior is to read several imperfect attempts, diagnose their partial insights and errors, and generate a new final solution that is better than any selection rule can obtain from the same set.

并行测试时扩展通常采样多个解答，再用多数投票或奖励模型选出一个。当正确候选已经存在时，这些程序可以利用它；但当所有采样候选都有错误时，它们无法构造正确解。顺序自我反思也并非完整补救：较小模型可能无法批评自己的推理，并且额外反思会使表现下降，因此更多词元不一定产生有用的纠错过程。

论文研究反思是否是一种区别于候选覆盖的能力，以及如何让较小模型获得这种能力。有效比较必须固定候选池，因为否则自我反思收益可能被误认为只是采样更多答案的普通好处。目标推理行为是阅读若干不完美尝试，诊断其部分洞见与错误，并生成一个比从同一集合中任何选择规则都更好的新最终解。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The authors define the Refinement Gap as selfRef@k minus maj@k: the improvement of a candidate-conditioned generative refinement pass over majority voting on exactly the same k solutions. Across instruction and thinking-model families from 1.5B to 72B, the gap rises with model scale and is only weakly related to ordinary pass@1 ability. This suggests that a model can be a capable direct solver yet remain a poor synthesizer of conflicting proposals.

Generative Self-Refinement transfers this synthesis behavior from high-gap teachers into a student. The student is trained jointly on direct solutions, so it can produce useful candidates, and on refined targets conditioned on its own candidate-like solutions, so it can repair and combine them. At inference it is still one model: it samples k attempts and then produces a candidate-conditioned final answer. The design makes the extra computation generative rather than merely selective.

作者把反思缺口定义为 selfRef@k 减去 maj@k，即在完全相同的 k 个解答上，条件生成式反思相对多数投票的改进。在 1.5B 到 72B 的指令模型与思维模型家族中，该缺口随模型规模上升，并且与普通 pass@1 能力只有较弱相关。这说明一个模型可以是有能力的直接求解器，却仍是相互冲突候选的糟糕综合者。

生成式自我反思把这种综合行为从高缺口教师迁移给学生。学生同时在直接解答上训练，以便生成有用候选；也在以自身候选式解答为条件的反思目标上训练，以便修复和组合它们。推理时它仍是一个模型：先采样 k 次尝试，再生成以候选为条件的最终答案。该设计使额外计算成为生成性的，而不只是选择性的。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each OpenMathReasoning problem, the student supplies four candidate responses to match its future test-time distribution. A high-gap teacher receives the question plus enumerated candidates and generates a refined target; these triples form the refinement data. The pipeline deliberately keeps difficult low-quality pools, including cases with zero correct candidates, because a training set containing only easy agreement cases would teach selection rather than correction. The teacher also supplies a direct target for the original question.

The final student minimizes an equal-weight combination of direct-solving and refinement negative log likelihood. The paper retains 184,000 instances of each type and fine-tunes Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, then runs the unified model in generate-then-refine mode. Main comparisons use four candidates and include majority voting, scalar and reasoning reward-model Best-of-N, and an 8B synthesizer. Evaluations cover five mathematics benchmarks and repeat AIME runs 32 times, with an additional input-scaling analysis from two through ten candidates.

对每个 OpenMathReasoning 问题，学生先提供四个候选回答，以匹配未来测试时的候选分布。高缺口教师接收问题及编号候选，并生成反思目标；这些三元组构成反思数据。流程刻意保留困难的低质量候选池，包括零个正确候选的情形，因为只含容易一致案例的训练集会教会选择，而非纠正。教师也为原始问题提供直接目标。

最终学生最小化直接求解与反思负对数似然的等权组合。论文各保留 184,000 条此类实例，微调 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，随后让统一模型以“生成后反思”方式运行。主要比较使用四个候选，包括多数投票、标量与推理奖励模型的 Best-of-N，以及一个 8B 综合器。评测覆盖五个数学基准，AIME 重复运行 32 次，并额外分析从两个到十个候选的输入扩展。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Before training, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct has a near-zero average Refinement Gap: on AIME24, pass@1 is 13.2%, maj@4 is 16.7%, and selfRef@4 is only 15.6%. After hybrid training, GSR-7B reaches 50.1% pass@1, 60.0% maj@4, and 66.0% selfRef@4 on AIME24. Across AIME24, AIME25, AMC22-23, MATH500, and OlympiadBench, its selfRef@4 average is 73.6%, compared with 70.5% for its own maj@4 and 70.9% for the strongest reported four-candidate reward-model selector.

The conditional analysis tests the claim that the model can exceed selection. With only one correct candidate out of four on AIME24, GSR selfRef@4 reaches 60.2%, while majority voting reaches 18.8%. When all four candidates are incorrect, the method still produces a correct solution 5.9% of the time, whereas selection baselines fail. The paper also reports that fine-tuned 14B and 32B models retain gains and that the candidate-conditioned skill transfers despite their training candidates having been generated by the 7B model.

训练前，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的平均反思缺口接近零：在 AIME24 上，pass@1 为 13.2%，maj@4 为 16.7%，selfRef@4 仅为 15.6%。混合训练后，GSR-7B 在 AIME24 上达到 50.1% 的 pass@1、60.0% 的 maj@4 和 66.0% 的 selfRef@4。在 AIME24、AIME25、AMC22-23、MATH500 和 OlympiadBench 上，其 selfRef@4 平均为 73.6%，高于自身 maj@4 的 70.5%，也高于报告中最强四候选奖励模型选择器的 70.9%。

条件分析检验了模型能超越选择的主张。当 AIME24 的四个候选中仅一个正确时，GSR 的 selfRef@4 达到 60.2%，而多数投票为 18.8%。当四个候选全错时，该方法仍有 5.9% 的概率产生正确解，而选择基线全部失败。论文还报告，微调后的 14B 和 32B 模型保持收益；尽管训练候选由 7B 模型生成，候选条件化技能仍能迁移。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The central novelty is to isolate refinement from sampling. Majority voting is a deterministic function of the same candidates, so the Refinement Gap makes a stronger claim than comparing a refined model with pass@1 or with a different candidate budget. It shows that parallel candidates can be used as evidence for a new solution, not merely as a pool from which to extract the least bad answer.

The hybrid objective is also materially different from distilling only polished solutions or only corrections. Direct-solving training improves the quality of the candidates that create refinement headroom, while refinement training teaches the model how to use partial and contradictory evidence. The method does not introduce a new external reward model or a stronger verifier; it changes the inference consumer itself into a learned candidate-conditioned generator, which is why it belongs to test-time scaling rather than ordinary instruction tuning.

核心新意是把反思与采样分离。多数投票是相同候选的确定性函数，因此反思缺口提出的主张强于把反思模型与 pass@1 或不同候选预算比较。它表明并行候选可作为构造新解的证据，而不仅是从中提取相对较好答案的池子。

混合目标也与仅蒸馏润色解答或仅蒸馏纠错有实质不同。直接求解训练提高产生反思空间的候选质量，而反思训练教会模型如何利用部分且相互矛盾的证据。该方法没有引入新的外部奖励模型或更强验证器；它把推理消费者本身变成学习到的候选条件生成器，因此属于测试时扩展而非普通指令微调。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The gains are demonstrated primarily on mathematical exact-answer tasks and depend on expensive teacher-generated direct and refinement targets. The candidate-conditioned prompt consumes additional context and one extra generation after sampling, so it may lose its advantage under strict latency or context limits. A high Refinement Gap does not guarantee factual grounding, tool correctness, or safety in open-ended settings, and the all-wrong-candidate result is still a low-probability recovery rather than a reliable replacement for external verification.
收益主要在数学精确答案任务上展示，并依赖昂贵的教师直接目标和反思目标。候选条件提示会消耗额外上下文，并在采样后增加一次生成，因此在严格的延迟或上下文限制下可能失去优势。高反思缺口并不保证开放式场景中的事实落地、工具正确性或安全性；全错候选结果仍是低概率恢复，而不是外部验证的可靠替代。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this approach when a system already samples several reasoning paths but majority voting or reranking leaves value on the table. Measure selfRef@k against maj@k on identical candidates before paying for a learned synthesizer, and include deliberately inconsistent and all-wrong pools in validation. In deployment, route only tasks with enough budget for a final synthesis pass, and retain an external verifier when the cost of a newly invented but plausible answer is high.
当系统已经采样多条推理路径、但多数投票或重排序仍未充分利用候选价值时，可使用此方法。在为学习式综合器付费前，应在完全相同候选上测量 selfRef@k 与 maj@k，并在验证中包含刻意不一致和全错的候选池。部署时，只把拥有足够预算进行最终综合的任务路由给该流程；若新编造但看似合理的答案代价很高，仍应保留外部验证器。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the table in matched candidate-budget pairs. The relevant comparison is GSR selfRef@4 against maj@4, BoN@4, and other refinement methods receiving four candidates, not against an unconstrained larger model. The data-construction choice is crucial: candidates are drawn from the student distribution and hard all-wrong sets are retained, so the reported behavior tests repair rather than simply teacher-answer imitation. Verify the appendix before reproducing teacher choice and prompts.
应按匹配的候选预算成对阅读表格。相关比较是获得四个候选的 GSR selfRef@4 与 maj@4、BoN@4 及其他反思方法，而不是与不受约束的大模型比较。数据构造选择很关键：候选来自学生分布，并保留困难的全错集合，因此报告的行为检验的是修复，而非简单模仿教师答案。复现教师选择和提示前应核对附录。
